## Better
- Read and edit settings opens the coding E-Sys just read, also when the same file was backed up earlier that day.
- Save names fit the folder: TAL saves are named TAL, and a name you typed last time is not kept for the next save.
- Show in folder works for folders with spaces in their names.
- Module info, the fault scan and the coding backup copy handle a car that disconnects or changes more safely.
- Settings and NCD working copies are saved more safely.
